name: layout-catalog
goal: Layouts contains reusable visual frames and shows each child slot in an image-only preview

evidence: Layouts means a reusable visual frame with a child slot. Exclude routing hosts and layout options. Reuse component cards with title, capture and page consumers; clearly mark child content; preserve old URLs and current navbar order. Focused checks only; full CLI/native deferred.

Opus 5.5 extracted ExplorerLayout and real child-slot previews. Layout cards reuse title/image/page-usage cards. Routing hosts stay components; layout options stay configs. Canonical URLs, legacy aliases and shared Web/Electron planning categories agree.
